evals.prompt: Release Mopheus v3.0.0 from a checkout whose origin points to another GitHub repository.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats enmotech/mopheus as the fixed release repository, rejects the mismatched checkout and origin during preflight, and performs no branch push, tag creation, workflow operation, or GitHub Release edit.
expectations: Treats enmotech/mopheus as the only valid GitHub repository.
Stops before every release write when repository identity mismatches.
Does not derive a replacement repository from the current checkout or origin.
